content.comment_body: I have four new [product_name] modules, and I created a program which downloaded successfully to one of the devices. However, when attempting to transfer the same program to the remaining three modules, I received a message stating, "You must use a newer version of this program." I'm confused, since I'm using the latest available version of [product_name] software, [version_no]. Does anyone have any suggestions? Thanks! [user_name]
Hello, Try updating to [version_no], which you can find at: [document], upgrades/updates, drivers Regards,

Thank you, [user_name]. I was able to solve my problem by following this process: Open [product_name] software, click: help > update Center > via Internet > [url] > update to [version_no]. That resolved the issue! Regards!
Hello, Yes, that’s another method to update your software. Occasionally, automatic updates aren’t found, which is why I shared the link to the latest version. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced a version compatibility issue when attempting to download a single program to multiple [product_name] modules. The software prompted for an updated program version, causing confusion as users believed they already had the latest version installed. This highlighted a gap in clarity around software versioning and updates, which was resolved by upgrading the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipated that their current version of [product_name] software would be compatible with all relevant hardware modules, assuming they had the most recent software and would not need further updates.
